name: Cloudflare Workers AI
tagline: Cloudflare Workers AI lets developers run AI inference workloads on Cloudflare's global edge network using serverless functions. It provides access to popular open-source models for text generation, embeddings, image classification, and translation with low latency and no GPU management.
